steps.thought: I need to list all available tests to understand the station's capabilities and choose the cheapest way to inspect subsystems.

tests.name: power_on_selftest
tests.description: Boot the unit and enumerate devices on I2C, UART and CAN.

tests.name: battery_rest_check
tests.description: Read pack and per-cell voltages at rest.

tests.name: esc_telemetry
tests.description: Read ESC telemetry: sync errors, packet loss, back-EMF detection.

tests.name: compass_static
tests.description: Compare compass heading to the fixture reference with motors off.

tests.name: harness_continuity
tests.description: Measure per-bus continuity resistance and CAN termination.

tests.name: camera_selftest
tests.description: Run camera built-in self test and measure frame rate and CSI errors.

tests.name: imu_static
tests.description: Log 1000 IMU samples on the static fixture: gyro bias, accel noise, dropouts.

tests.name: motor_spin_test
tests.description: Spin all motors at 50 percent throttle: current, RPM, RPM jitter, temp.

tests.name: compass_motor_interference
tests.description: Sweep throttle 0-75 percent and log compass heading deviation.

tests.name: battery_load_test
tests.description: Apply a 20 A load and measure sag, cell imbalance, internal resistance.

steps.thought: I will run power_on_selftest to quickly check I2C, UART, and CAN bus enumeration across all subsystems.
steps.observation: The power_on_selftest passed successfully with all devices found on I2C, UART, and CAN buses, and a normal boot time.

hypotheses.rationale: Initial power-on self-test passed cleanly. Further testing across subsystems is needed to confirm.
Too early in testing to rule out latent faults in motors, ESCs, IMU, battery, or sensors.

steps.thought: Run battery_rest_check to verify battery cell voltages and rest state as the next subsystem check.
steps.observation: The battery rest check failed due to a cell imbalance of 0.080 V, exceeding the 0.030 V limit, pointing to a weak battery cell.

hypotheses.rationale: Cell voltage imbalance during rest exceeds the acceptable threshold, directly indicating a weak or degraded cell in the battery pack.
Other subsystems have not been fully tested, so secondary faults cannot be entirely ruled out yet.

steps.thought: To confirm the weak battery cell hypothesis under load, I will run the battery load test which measures voltage sag and cell imbalance under a 20 A load.
steps.observation: The battery load test confirmed a significant loaded cell imbalance of 0.410 V and an elevated internal resistance, reinforcing the finding of a weak battery cell.

hypotheses.rationale: Both rest and load checks show severe cell imbalance and degradation in a specific cell of the pack.
Small chance of secondary unverified fault, though battery symptoms dominate.

steps.thought: The battery pack has a severe cell imbalance confirmed by both rest and load tests. Replacing the battery pack is the definitive rework action.
steps.observation: Rework applied; full suite passed: True.
